Approved logo files

  • Use the approved logo file. Never redraw, retype, stretch or recolour it.
  • Keep at least the height of the H mark clear around the logo. The builder checks placement and clear space in every size.
  • Keep the real product separate from the room scene. Review the transparent cutout before delivering an ad.
  • Use Montserrat for ad copy, gold #EBA800 for the call to action, and the exact palette above.
  • Sample copy illustrates the layout. Check product claims and enter the actual offer and deadline before generating.
